body.name: \(\mathcal F_0(p),\mathcal F_+(p)\)
body.construction: \(\Theta_{\mathcal L}=\{\theta\in\prod_{s\in S}\Delta(\Omega_s):\prod_s\lambda_{s,u_s}>0\Rightarrow g(u)\in\mathcal L\}\), \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\{\theta\in\Theta_{\mathcal L}:\Phi(\theta)=p\}\), and \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\{\theta\in\mathcal F_0(p):K(\theta)>0\}\).
